decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY covering both success-modal buttons, including the separate optional-tip transaction and no-code random-referral finalization without automatic transaction popups.
The accepted success-modal transaction UX does not change how fiat buyers access commissions, tickets, prizes, or dashboard reward information.
Using a separate post-mint transaction for an optional tip does not change ETH payment, swap, refund, or NFT-mint execution.
The source changes optional post-success actions, not the USDC approval or NFT-mint flow.
The accepted modal behavior does not alter background wallet creation, custody, key control, or seed-phrase requirements for fiat buyers.
The source does not change the Transak provider, supported fiat methods, fiat-to-USDC conversion, or automatic NFT mint initiation.
An optional tip sent in a separate transaction does not modify the required $15 primary mint price or its no-hidden-fees commitment.
The source concerns post-mint optional actions and does not enable, disable, or change the selectability of any mint payment method.
The NFT ebook product type and unlimited supply model remain unchanged by the post-success tip transaction choice.
The optional tip is a separate post-mint transaction and does not change allocation of the required $15 primary-sale proceeds.
The accepted option does not change payment-currency disclosure or selection between ETH and USDC.

The source selects success-modal transaction behavior but does not request About-page copy changes; its existing high-level reward descriptions can remain valid without a necessary textual modification.
